scope: フレームワーク製品ではなく、フレームワーク上に本番級境界と検証を置くケーススタディ

sourceManifest.maintenanceInterpretation: GitHub repository is not archived, but recent repository activity is not inferred from stars or metadata updates
sourceManifest.authorScope: The README presents a production-oriented implementation example while excluding requirements analysis, strategic DDD, infrastructure/deployment process and ongoing maintenance concerns; it explicitly warns that architecture must fit the problem context
historicalCaveats: IdentityServer Resource Owner Password flow shown by the case is historical and must not be copied as a current security default
Library versions and SQL Stream Store choices are evidence of this revision, not current product recommendations
The case contains no event-sourcing snapshot implementation

domainModel.strategicScope: Strategic DDD and domain discovery are explicitly out of scope; bounded modules shown here are implementation evidence, not proof that the contexts were optimally discovered
domainModel.aggregateInvariant: An aggregate owns business invariants and is the transaction consistency boundary; public behavior changes state and emits domain events
domainModel.encapsulationInvariant: Only the module contract is externally visible. OOP private/internal keywords are one mechanism; other languages must enforce the same ownership through module visibility and dependency gates
domainModel.persistence: Domain types remain persistence ignorant; infrastructure maps them to a module-owned database schema
domainModel.databaseBoundary: Modules may share one physical database deployment while owning separate schemas. Sharing a database server is not the same as sharing tables/schema
domainModel.integrationDependency: Other modules depend only on published integration-event contracts, not internal domain/data types
domainModel.cost: More projects, mapping code, workers, eventual consistency and operational recovery. Simple CRUD contexts may use a thinner model rather than imitating every layer

sequence: HTTP adapter authenticates/authorizes and creates typed command/query
handler runs write aggregate or read projection
unit-of-work decorator dispatches domain events and commits
commandQuery.failurePropagation: Validation/handler exceptions abort commit in the reference case; functional mappings translate expected failures into closed result values while unexpected defects remain faults
commandQuery.commandResultTradeoff: Returning a created identifier is practical but blurs strict command/query separation; the case records this as an ADR
commandQuery.mediatorTradeoff: Loose invoker/handler coupling and uniform decorators versus runtime indirection and harder handler discovery
commandQuery.cqrsBoundary: Read and write models differ; separate databases are not required

delivery: record published/processed state with bounded retry
consumerTransaction: commit domain change and processed marker
outboxInbox.guarantee: at-least-once delivery and at-least-once processing; never exactly-once
outboxInbox.ordering: Define only the scope that needs order, such as one aggregate stream; do not claim global order
outboxInbox.poisonPolicy: Bound retries, preserve payload/failure, quarantine for operator review and allow explicit replay

crashPoints.replay: neither domain change nor outbox is visible
duplicate delivery is accepted and consumer idempotency suppresses duplicate effect

crashPoints.point: after inbox insert before consumer commit
crashPoints.replay: transaction rollback makes inbox and domain change both retryable
duplicate is detected by processed inbox marker

outboxInbox.directCallTradeoff: Forbidding direct module calls lowers data/type coupling and permits extraction, but adds latency, eventual consistency and recovery operations

projection: commit projection and checkpoint together or make replay safe

migration.additive: new readers accept old event versions
migration.upcast: pure adapters transform historical payloads without rewriting history
migration.destructive: forbidden without export, rehearsal, rollback/forward recovery and retained original stream

eventStore.snapshot: not implemented by the reference case; absence is recorded, not advertised as a feature
eventStore.storagePolicy: SQL Stream Store is case evidence only. Framework mappings depend on an event-store port, not that library

testEvidence.proves: public aggregate behavior and business rules in isolation
declared dependencies, visibility and naming conventions
testEvidence.doesNotProve: runtime behavior; compiler rules are preferred when possible

testEvidence.proves: one use case with controlled real database and module composition
observable multi-module asynchronous result with polling timeout
selected test assertions kill code mutations
testEvidence.doesNotProve: complete requirements; coverage alone is not adequacy

testEvidence.proves: repeatable public-API setup for manual/system tests
testEvidence.doesNotProve: the scenario assertions unless a test observes them

patterns.name: Bounded modules
patterns.problem: 単一deployableの内部でdomain ownershipと変更影響を局所化する
patterns.invariant: 他moduleは公開integration event contract以外へ依存しない
patterns.failureMode: 共有model/databaseを直接参照すると境界が名目化する

patterns.name: CQRS handler pipeline
patterns.problem: use caseとcross-cutting concernを分離する
patterns.invariant: 状態変更はcommand境界を通り、commitは一つのunit of workで行う
patterns.failureMode: mediatorの間接層がhandler探索とtraceを難しくする

patterns.name: Transactional Outbox/Inbox
patterns.problem: database commitとmodule event配送のdual writeを避ける
patterns.mechanism: producer transactionでoutboxへ記録し、consumerはinboxで重複を検出する
patterns.failureMode: exactly-onceと誤認すると再配送で副作用が重複する

patterns.name: Event Sourcing
patterns.problem: aggregate stateを事実列から復元しprojectionを独立更新する
patterns.mechanism: expected version付きevent stream、aggregate replay、subscription checkpoint、projection
patterns.invariant: 現在状態はevent historyから復元可能で、監査ログだけならEvent Sourcingと呼ばない。projectionはcheckpointと同じtransactionまたは冪等再実行で進む
patterns.failureMode: event version/upcasting、projection replay、poison event、破壊的migrationを無設計にすると復旧不能になる。参照事例にsnapshot実装がないことを機能として誤記しない

patterns.name: Executable architecture
patterns.problem: 文書化したdependency ruleが時間とともに腐る
patterns.mechanism: architecture testsでlayer、visibility、naming、DDD conventionを検査する
patterns.invariant: compilerで守れないload-bearing ruleには失敗するgateを置く
patterns.failureMode: ファイル名だけを検査しsemantic dependencyを見なければ偽の安心になる

patterns.name: Layered evidence
patterns.problem: 純粋domain ruleから非同期module統合まで異なる失敗を検出する
patterns.mechanism: unit、architecture、integration、system integration、mutation testを分離し、localとCIで同じbuild logicを呼ぶ
patterns.invariant: 非同期testはobservable effectとtimeoutを持つ。所有するDBはproduction相当を使い、元に戻せない外部APIだけをtest doubleにする
patterns.failureMode: sleep固定待機やin-memory代替だけでは競合とDB差を隠す。code coverageをadequacyと同一視せずmutation survivorを要求漏れとして調べる。共通build DSLにはtooling costもある

mappings.moduleBoundary: Spring Modulith application modulesまたはJava package boundary。ArchUnit/Modulith verificationで依存を固定
mappings.commandQuery: Application serviceまたは明示的handler。AOP/ordered interceptorsはdecorator順序をtestで固定
mappings.effects: transactional service + TransactionSynchronization。domain eventとexternal integration eventを分離
mappings.outboxInbox: 同一RDB transactionのoutbox、scheduler/CDC publisher、consumer idempotency key
mappings.eventSourcing: 通常のJPA modelと混同せず、必要なaggregateだけevent store adapterへ
mappings.testing: plain domain unit、ApplicationContext slice、Testcontainers integration、ArchUnit/Modulith structure
mappings.warning: Spring Modulithは参照caseと同一物ではない。auto-configurationの暗黙性をmodule-owned configやdomain modelへ漏らさず、condition reportとstartup gateを証拠にする
mappings.lifecycle: Spring transactionでdomain writeとoutboxをcommitし、external event publicationはcommit後。container beanをdomain objectへ注入しない
mappings.architectureGate: src/test/java/.../ArchitectureTests.java でmodule package dependency、domainからSpring/adapterへの依存禁止、公開event contractだけの参照をArchUnitまたはSpring Modulithで検査

patternDecisions.reason: Spring Modulith verificationを利用できるがmodule ownershipはapplicationが宣言する
AOPだけに隠さずordered handler decoratorをtestする
RDB transactionとexternal publicationのdual writeを除く
必要なaggregateだけに限定しJPA defaultにしない
package/module ruleを実行可能にする
Spring contextとreal dependency差を段階別に検出する

mappings.moduleBoundary: Python packageの公開portとcomposition moduleを分離。import graphを静的gateで検査
mappings.commandQuery: route dependencyは認証/transaction contextまで。use case handlerへHTTP objectを渡さない
mappings.effects: async context managerでresource lifetime、Result/Either相当のdomain failureをHTTP adapterで変換
mappings.outboxInbox: SQL transaction内outboxとbackground publisher。FastAPI BackgroundTasksをdurable queueとして扱わない
mappings.eventSourcing: event schema/version/checkpointをapplication protocolとして明示
mappings.testing: pure domain test、dependency override boundary test、実DB integration、ASGI end-to-end
mappings.warning: Pydantic request modelをdomain entity/ORM rowと同一化しない。DependsとOpenAPIは便利だがdomain/module boundaryの代替ではない
mappings.lifecycle: request-scoped AsyncSessionはyield dependency/async context managerでcloseし、detached taskへ渡さない。BackgroundTasksはresponse後実行でありdurable deliveryではない
mappings.architectureGate: tests/architecture/test_import_boundaries.py でdomain→FastAPI/SQLAlchemy import、module間internal import、HTTP modelのapplication流入を拒否

patternDecisions.reason: package公開portとimport gateで所有権を実装
Dependsをhandler locatorにせずplain callableを合成
BackgroundTasksではdurabilityを証明できない
event protocolをPydantic/DB modelから独立version化
Python import自由度をCI gateで補う
dependency overrideだけでなくreal DB/ASGI境界を通す

mappings.moduleBoundary: Go internal packageと小さいport interface。main/composition rootだけがadapterを配線
mappings.commandQuery: Gin ContextはHTTP adapter内で値へdecodeし、command/query handlerはcontext.Contextとtyped inputを受け取る
mappings.effects: 明示的function composition、deferによるresource cleanup、typed error mapping
mappings.outboxInbox: sql.Txへaggregate writeとoutbox insertを同居させ、workerは別processでも再開可能にする
mappings.testing: table-driven domain test、package dependency check、real database integration、httptest boundary
mappings.warning: middlewareへbusiness ruleを積むと順序依存の隠れたapplication frameworkになる
mappings.lifecycle: Gin Contextはrequest中だけHTTP adapterが所有する。goroutineには必要値とrequest.Context派生scopeだけを渡し、server shutdownでaccept停止→task cancel→bounded drainを行う
mappings.architectureGate: internal/によるvisibility、go list -deps/import graph、import cycle compiler error、staticcheckでdomain→gin/sql adapter依存を拒否

patternDecisions.reason: internal packageと小さいport interfaceでcompiler支援が得られる
mediator libraryよりconstructor wiringとfunction decoratorを第一案にする
sql.Tx内でdomain writeとoutbox insertをatomicにする
storage libraryではなくexpected-version portだけをcoreへ
internal/import/compiler/staticcheckを組み合わせる
table test、real DB、httptest、fault injectionを分離

mappings.moduleBoundary: moduleが公開port、owned data、effect capability、integration contractを一宣言する
mappings.commandQuery: ADT command/queryとpure handlerを中心に、logging/validation/unit-of-workを順序付きinterpreterで合成
mappings.effects: Functional Core / Imperative Shell。Clock、Random、DB、HTTP、Spawnをcapabilityとして明示し、scopeで解放
mappings.outboxInbox: transaction capabilityがdomain writeとoutboxを一commitし、delivery interpreterはat-least-onceとidempotencyを型・gateで要求
mappings.eventSourcing: Event<A>のversioned codec、NonEmpty history、expected revision、projection checkpointを標準port候補にする
mappings.testing: pure law/property、architecture ownership、adapter contract、real dependency、fault injection、mutation相当のgate
mappings.warning: reflection/container/class inheritanceを持ち込まず、Monadという語をAPI表面に露出すること自体を目的にしない。expected failureはexceptionでなくclosed ADTにする
mappings.lifecycle: Clock/Random/DB/HTTP/Log/Spawn capabilityをargumentにし、scoped task、cancel、backpressure、replayをruntime gateで証明する。現時点でlanguage/runtime capabilityが不足する部分はblockedとして分離
mappings.architectureGate: module declarationからowned core/shell/contract/testsを検証し、producer gateでevent schema driftと未付与capability参照を拒否

patternDecisions.reason: core/shell/contract/tests ownershipを一宣言し#36へ実装
class mediatorでなくADT command/queryとinterpreterへ
transaction/outboxは#23、concurrency/idempotencyは#6/#19の実行能力に依存
optional durable workflowとして#23へ。core requirementにはしない
capabilityとmodule schema driftをproducer gateで拒否
pure law、byte replay #4、real adapter、fault injectionへ翻訳

adoptionOrder: module ownershipと禁止dependencyを先に宣言しarchitecture gateを置く
一つのuse caseをpure core + typed effect boundaryとして通す
transaction + outbox + idempotent inboxを故障注入で検証する
同期境界で十分でない箇所だけevent sourcingまたは非同期統合を導入する
unitからsystemまで各testが何を証明しないかを記録する
